interface.ui: Sign-in for the gate preview: GET /auth/preview (redirects to / with an owner session). System page: route "/system" (reached from the navigation link "System"), page title "System · Agents", h1 "System". NEW: a card whose heading (h2) is exactly "Project Capabilities", placed on /system together with the existing cards. It contains a table with the column headers, in this order: "Project", "Language", "Framework", "Package manager", "Build", "Test", "Lint", "Type-check", "Browser tests"; one body row per configured (active) project, whose "Project" cell shows the project name (preview: "Demo Project"). Language cell: the detected language(s), comma-separated (preview: "typescript"). Framework cell: the detected framework (preview: "next"). Package manager cell: the detected package manager (preview: "npm"). A language/framework/package manager that was not detected is shown as "Not detected". Build, Test, Lint and Type-check cells: visible text starting with "Available" (it may be followed by the detected command, e.g. "Available npm run build") when the profile records that command, otherwise exactly "Not available". Browser tests cell: "Available" when the profile records browser tests, otherwise "Not available". Preview values for "Demo Project": Build "Available", Test "Available", Lint "Not available", Type-check "Available", Browser tests "Not available". A project whose capability profile has not been detected yet still has its row, showing the text "Not detected yet" and no "Available" cell. Existing cards stay: "Backups", "Recent executor errors", "Administrative operations (audit log)", plus the heartbeat, "Build" and "Executor jobs" tiles.

non_goals: Any execution-ledger view (per-run task class, worker, harness, model, provider, route reason, permission envelope, context files, failure class) on the System page or elsewhere - the owner decided the title was a mislabel.
Changing how capability profiles are detected (src/domain/profile.ts rules), when they are refreshed, or what is stored in projects.capability_profile; triggering a new detection from the UI.
Editing, overriding or confirming a project's capabilities from the UI; any new form, button or API under /api/v0.
Showing the other profile fields (database, tooling list, Dockerfile check stage, unknown list, detection commit) - they may be shown but are not required.
Showing capabilities on other pages (Command page, project pages, task pages).
Creating, editing or removing projects; changing sign-in, sessions or authorization.
Changing the existing System page cards (heartbeats, Build, Executor jobs, Backups, Recent executor errors, Administrative operations (audit log)) or its live refresh.

scope.summary: The System page (/system) gains a section headed "Project Capabilities" that lists every configured (active) project with its detected Project Capability Profile: the detected language(s), framework and package manager, and whether build, test, lint, type-check and browser-test capabilities are available. The values come from the capability profile the control system already records per project (detected from the project's own repository files); a project whose profile has not been detected yet is still listed and says so. The gate preview's demonstration project "Demo Project" carries a demonstration capability profile so the section can be checked black-box. All existing System page sections keep working unchanged. Per the owner's decision, the task title "Execution ledger on the System page" was a mislabel: no execution-ledger view is part of this task.
